basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and virtual fashion enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. SkyHighTrader1987 has been trading virtual items in Royale High for over five years, always on the lookout for the newest and rarest pieces. Outside of gaming, they enjoy experimenting with DIY projects, particularly those that blend their love for design and engineering. Typically online during the late evenings, they work as a freelance web designer, balancing their time between creative projects and leisure. Currently single, they enjoy the freedom to immerse themselves fully in their hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: SkyHighTrader1987 possesses extensive knowledge of in-game economics and trading strategies in Royale High, acquired through years of active participation and community engagement. Their expertise is mostly self-taught, supplemented by tutorials and discussions within the gaming community. Additionally, their background in web design gives them a keen eye for aesthetics and user experience.
